metrics.name: PCK
metrics.definition: A keypoint is counted correct when its distance to the annotation is below a normalized threshold.
metrics.teachingNote: PCK emphasizes coordinate accuracy after normalizing by head size, torso size or bbox size.

metrics.name: OKS
metrics.definition: COCO keypoint metric that compares predicted and annotated joints with per-joint scale factors.
metrics.teachingNote: OKS plays a role similar to IoU for keypoints and is used for keypoint AP.

metrics.name: Pose Vector
metrics.definition: [x0, y0, score0, x1, y1, score1, ...] or normalized variants.
metrics.teachingNote: Action recognition can consume pose vectors frame by frame as a compact body-structure signal.
